Post for Trainee Engineer
Friday, 01 June 2018
4500 Hits
Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram invites applications on plain paper enclosed with the certified photocopies of the educational qualification and experience are invited for the post of Trainee Engineer (Electrical) (post is purely temporary for a period of one year only). The application must reach to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Po. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 latest by
15th June 2018
. Candidates must have to submit copy of registration with Employment Exchange. Candidates belonging to Reserve Category should submit copy of Caste and Validity certificate.
Qualification – B.E./B.Tech. (Electrical) from Govt. recognized Institute.
Salary: Consolidated Rs.10000/- per month (for one year only)
Age Limit: Between 18 to 35 years
Note:
1. Suitable and experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in age limit.
2. Decision of Selection Committee will be final.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
